text:
Type: dark grey linen cushion
Use: on a sofa, an armchair or a bed; living room, bedroom
Style: minimalist, Scandinavian, contemporary
Materials: washed linen-blend fabric with a visible slub weave, simple flat seams
Colors: dark charcoal grey, cool tone
Shape: plain square cushion with clean straight edges, softly crumpled surface, full and plump, classic sofa size
Feel: calm, grounded, relaxed, understated
Goes with: light grey or white sofas, natural wood, black accents, mixed neutral cushions; minimalist, Scandinavian or industrial rooms
